notes.title: 《Jumping Master》Service announcement
notes.notes:
Dear "Jumping Master" players:
Since "Jumping Master" was officially launched, it has received strong support and love from the majority of players. Looking back on the countless happy days that everyone has spent since the opening of the server, I am sincerely grateful for your support and help! Like all players, during this period of time has established an inseparable emotion for "Jumping Master".
However, there is no permanent banquet in the world. Due to the redesign of Jumping Master gameplay and the adjustment of research and development strategies, the game is about to be taken off the shelves. It is also an extremely painful choice for us. We express our deep regret and apologies for the trouble caused by this game closure! And will work hard to do the final operation work, accompany you to spend the remaining game time together, I hope you have fun in the last time!
"Jumping Master" will officially stop operating on July 31, 2020
 Schedule of customs service process:
"Jumping Master" suspension related matters
1. "Jumping Master" will stop recharging service at 10:00 am on Friday, July 24, 2020.
2. "Jumping Master" will remove the game installation packages from all channels at 10:00 am on Friday, July 24, 2020
3. "Jumping Master" will officially shut down the server at 10:00 am on Friday, July 31, 2020, and close its corresponding connection at the same time.
3. "Jumping Master" will close customer service, comments, special areas and other content services at 14:00 on July 31, 2020
Before the server is closed, you can still experience all the game content open in the current game normally. I hope everyone can have fun in the last time!
